method: 60% chronological training / 40% holdout by symbol and timeframe; 0.01 lots; median observed spread per symbol and one adverse tick per fill; holdout stress at 1.5x spread; no live orders

sma_micro_trend.model: existing SMA research simulator; 0.01 lot, $0.27 stop and 3R target

dow_theory.model: confirmed Dow swings; next-bar-open fills; opposite swing stop; no add/reverse

meanrev-bb-rsi-v1.model: implemented BB + RSI rules; 0.01 lot; percent stop and RR target

gold-scalping-v1.description: TradingView documentation example: SMA 9/21, XAUUSD, SL 25 and TP 50 price units.
gold-scalping-v1.limitation: No independent gold-scalping algorithm or verified historical contract-value specification is present; do not compare this example with optimized strategies.

known_limits: This is a research simulator, not MT5 execution; OHLC bars cannot determine intrabar order when stop and target are both crossed, so stop is assumed first.
Parameter selection across a finite holdout creates selection bias; use a new later sample for independent confirmation.
Historical spread by bar, commissions, swaps, latency, account position limits, and broker rejections are not fully simulated.
The gold-scalping-v1 Pine script in docs is explicitly an integration example, not a defined production algorithm.
